summary: This note is a short wiki-style excerpt on the Michigan State Spartans men's basketball program's NCAA tournament record. It reports the team's 32 NCAA tournament appearances, a 21-year consecutive streak from 1998 to 2018, and nine Final Four appearances. It also notes the program's ninth-place all-time NCAA tournament winning percentage through 2018.
one_line: Summary of Michigan State Spartans men's basketball NCAA tournament appearances, streaks, Final Four trips and winning percentage through 2018.
key_facts: The Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team has participated in 32 NCAA tournaments.
The Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team appeared in 21 consecutive NCAA tournaments from 1998 to 2018.
The 21-consecutive-tournament streak is the fifth-longest streak ever in college basketball.
The 21-consecutive-tournament streak is the third-longest active streak in college basketball.
Kansas has the longest active NCAA tournament streak at 28, according to the note.
Duke has an active NCAA tournament streak of 22, according to the note.
Michigan State has the seventh most all-time Final Four appearances with nine.
Michigan State reached the Final Four in 1957, 1979, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2005, 2009, 2010, and 2015.
The Michigan State Spartans men's basketball program is ninth all-time in NCAA tournament winning percentage.
The Michigan State program's NCAA tournament winning percentage was .677 through 2018.
